parameters.name: DstEntityId
parameters.description: The destination entity ID. You can use the table or field ID returned by the ListTables or ListColumns operation, or use a custom entity ID.

parameters.name: DstEntityName
parameters.description: The destination entity name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Default value: Asc. Valid values:

- Asc: ascending order.
- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sort field. Default value: Name.

parameters.name: SrcEntityId
parameters.description:
The source entity ID. You can use the table or field ID returned by the ListTables or ListColumns operation, or use a custom entity ID.

To obtain a table or field entity ID, first call ListCrawlers to obtain the MetaEntityId of the metadata crawler. For types that contain a data catalog level, such as DLF and StarRocks, call ListCatalogs to obtain the catalog ID. Then call ListDatabases to obtain the database ID. If necessary, call ListSchemas to obtain the schema ID. Finally, call ListTables or ListColumns to obtain the table or field ID.

parameters.name: SrcEntityName
parameters.description: The source entity name. Fuzzy match is supported.
